description:
Render a Bitcoin on-chain analytics chart as a PNG image or SVG. PREFERRED tool for visualization — produces a beautiful chart without flooding context with raw data.

Use this when the user asks to "show", "chart", "plot", "graph", "visualize", or "dynamics" of any metric. Also use for entity-specific charts (MSTR, Tesla, IBIT) — pass params: {entity: "name"} or {ticker: "IBIT"}.

Smart defaults: just provide metric IDs and you get a beautiful chart. Customize with optional params.

Supports custom Y-axes with vertical zones (stack volume below price), domain clamping, reference lines, reference areas, and computed formula series.

IMPORTANT — Multi-axis guidance for different units:
When combining metrics with different units (e.g., BTC supply + USD price, or a dimensionless ratio + USD), ALWAYS place them on separate Y-axes. Otherwise one metric will appear as a flat line near zero due to scale mismatch. Use list_metrics to check the "unit" field and assign metrics with different units to different axes (left vs right).

Examples:
- Simple: render_chart({ metric: "price" })
- Multi-metric: render_chart({ metrics: ["lth_supply", "sth_supply"], days: 730, style: "area" })
- Template: render_chart({ template: "mvrv_ratio" })
- Custom: render_chart({ metrics: [{ id: "price", axis: "right" }, { id: "lth_mvrv", axis: "left" }], days: 365, title: "Price vs MVRV" })
- Multi-unit (separate axes): render_chart({ metrics: [{ id: "lth_supply", axis: "left" }, { id: "price", axis: "right" }], days: 365 })
- Vertical zones: render_chart({ metrics: [{ id: "price", y_axis_id: "ax-p" }, { id: "volume", y_axis_id: "ax-v", style: "bar" }], y_axes: [{ id: "ax-p", side: "right", range: [20, 100] }, { id: "ax-v", side: "left", range: [0, 20] }] })
- Reference line: render_chart({ metric: "lth_mvrv", reference_lines: [{ y: 3.5, label: "Overheated", stroke: "#ef4444", dash: "3 3" }] })
- Reference area: render_chart({ metric: "lth_mvrv", reference_areas: [{ y1: 0, y2: 0.85, label: "Undervalued", fill: "#22c55e", fill_opacity: 0.15 }] })
- Formula (ratio): render_chart({ metrics: [{ id: "lth_supply" }, { id: "sth_supply" }], formulas: [{ expression: "m1 / m2", label: "LTH/STH Ratio", color: "#f59e0b" }], days: 365 })
- Formula on separate axis: render_chart({ metrics: [{ id: "lth_supply", axis: "left" }, { id: "sth_supply", axis: "left" }], formulas: [{ expression: "m1 / m2", label: "LTH/STH Ratio", y_axis_id: "ax-r" }], y_axes: [{ id: "ax-r", side: "right" }], days: 365 })
- Formula with rolling-window warmup: render_chart({ metric: "mvrv", formulas: [{ expression: "(m1 - sma(m1, 365)) / std(m1, 365)", label: "MVRV Z-Score" }], days: 1460, warmup_days: 365 }) — pass warmup_days >= window size of sma/std/shift so the first displayed day has a valid value (otherwise the leading 365 days render empty)
- Per-entity: render_chart({ metric: "etf_ticker_btc_holdings", params: { ticker: "IBIT" }, days: 365 })
- DAT entity (single metric): render_chart({ metric: "dat_entity_realized_price", params: { id: "59" }, days: 365 })
- DAT entity by name: render_chart({ metric: "dat_entity_holdings", params: { entity: "tesla" }, days: 365 })
- DAT entity (Strategy/MSTR): render_chart({ metrics: [{ id: "dat_entity_holdings", axis: "left" }, { id: "dat_entity_realized_price", axis: "right" }], params: { id: "1" }, days: 2000, title: "Strategy (MSTR) — Holdings & Cost Basis" })
- ETF fund (IBIT): render_chart({ metrics: [{ id: "etf_ticker_btc_holdings", axis: "left" }, { id: "etf_ticker_realized_price", axis: "right" }], params: { ticker: "IBIT" }, days: 730, title: "IBIT — Holdings & Realized Price" })
- Cycle comparison (ATH): render_chart({ metrics: [{ id: "cycle_ath_1", color: "#8b5cf6" }, { id: "cycle_ath_2", color: "#3b82f6" }, { id: "cycle_ath_3", color: "#22c55e" }, { id: "cycle_ath_4", color: "#f59e0b" }, { id: "cycle_ath_5", color: "#171717" }], x_axis: "day_offset", y_axes: [{ id: "left", side: "left", scale: "log" }], title: "Price Performance Since ATH" })
- Cycle comparison (Low): render_chart({ metrics: ["cycle_low_1", "cycle_low_2", "cycle_low_3", "cycle_low_4"], x_axis: "day_offset", scale: "log", title: "Price Since Cycle Low" })
- Cycle comparison (Halving): render_chart({ metrics: ["cycle_halving_1", "cycle_halving_2", "cycle_halving_3", "cycle_halving_4"], x_axis: "day_offset", scale: "log" })
- Heatmap (CBD): render_chart({ heatmap_id: "cost-basis-distribution", heatmap_period: "1y", heatmap_color_scale: "viridis", theme: "dark", title: "Cost Basis Distribution" })

format.description: Output format: png (raster image), svg (vector image), or json (metadata only, no render)

formulas.description: Computed series derived from metric data. Formulas reference metrics by position (m1, m2, ...) and support arithmetic (+, -, *, /), plus sma(series, window), std(series, window), shift(series, days), max(a, b), min(a, b). Set warmup_days >= largest rolling window for valid values from day 0.

expression.description: Math expression referencing metrics by position: m1, m2, etc. E.g. "m1 / m2", "m1 - m2", "m1 * 100", "sma(m1, 200)", "(m1 - sma(m1, 365)) / std(m1, 365)"

label.description: Display name for the computed series

show_in_legend.description: Show in chart legend (default: true). Set false to hide from legend.

stack_group.description: Stack group ID for stacked formula bars (e.g. inflow/outflow split bars).

style.description: Chart style for this formula series

y_axis_id.description: Y-axis ID to bind this series to

heatmap_id.description: Render a heatmap instead of a line chart. Currently supports: "cost-basis-distribution". Mutually exclusive with metric/metrics/template.

heatmap_y_scale.description: Y-axis scale for heatmap price bins (default: "log")

metric.description: Single metric ID (e.g., "price", "lth_supply", "lth_mvrv"). Use list_metrics to discover IDs.

label.description: Display label (legend / hover). Auto from registry if omitted.

show_in_legend.description: Show in chart legend (default: true). Set false to render data but hide from legend.

stack_group.description: Stack group ID — area/bar series with the same group stack on top of each other (e.g. LTH + STH supply stacked to circulating).

stroke_width.description: Line stroke width 0-5. 0 = no line (data still computed for formula references).

y_axis_id.description: Exact Y-axis ID (e.g. "ax-z"). Overrides `axis` when set. Required for 3+ axis charts where left/right alone is ambiguous.

metrics.description: Multiple metrics. Pass as string array ["price", "lth_supply"] for simple, or objects for customization. Object fields mirror the backend POST schema — see /v1/chart/snapshot for the full reference.

overlay.description: Add BTC price overlay (subtle dashed line)

params.description: Runtime parameters for entity-filtered metrics. E.g., { ticker: "IBIT" } for ETF per-fund metrics, { id: "59" } for DAT entity metrics, { exchange: "binance" } for per-exchange metrics. Use list_metrics to see which metrics require params (check params_schema field).

reference_areas.description: Shaded reference zones between two Y values. Example: highlight when MVRV < 0.85

reference_lines.description: Horizontal reference lines on the chart

style.description: Default chart style for all metrics

template.description: Chart template ID. Templates: price, price_volume, market_cap, holder_supply, mvrv_ratio, realized_price, realized_cap, unrealized_pl, realized_pl, sopr, block_height, realized_volatility, coindays_destroyed, dormancy_flow, liveliness

warmup_days.description: Extra days fetched BEFORE the displayed range for formula rolling-window warmup. Use with formulas containing sma(m, N) / std(m, N) / shift(m, N) — pass warmup_days >= N so the first displayed day already has a valid computed value. Without it, the leading N days of the chart show empty for the formula series. Example: { formulas: [{ expression: "sma(m1, 365)" }], days: 1460, warmup_days: 365 } renders a 4y chart of a 365-day SMA with no empty leading year.

x_axis.description: X-axis mode. "date" (default) for calendar dates. "day_offset" for cycle comparison charts — all cycles start at Day 0 and overlay for comparison. Required for cycle_ath_*, cycle_low_*, cycle_halving_* metrics.

y_axes.description: Custom Y-axes with vertical zones. Use range to stack axes (e.g. volume [0,20], price [20,100]). Use domain_min/domain_max to clamp axis bounds.

id.description: Unique axis identifier, referenced by y_axis_id on metrics/formulas

range.description: Vertical zone [from%, to%] as a 2-element array. 0=bottom, 100=top. E.g. [0, 20] for bottom 20%

side.description: Which side of the chart the axis appears on

name: render_chart
